messages:
olivia: Quick sync — planning a joint marketplace lift for H100 (partner image), MI300 beta, and Gaudi nodes. Need a final gating checklist + ops handoff. Who can own the handoff and escalation path?

sam: I can take ops handoff. Current blocker: H100 firmware RC2 is triggering kernel OOMs under sustained batching in our perf runs. I need Nvidia escalation or a rollback plan. :eyes:

alex: Runtime note: MI300 quantized runtime shows a 5-8% perf regression at seq=2048 compared to our baseline. There's a canary patch, but SI validation required. Canary image: `redwood/runtime:mi300-qfix-2024-03`

maria: Marketing asks for a 2-week heads-up before any public announce. Can we pin a soft publish date so they can draft joint comms?

jin: Infra check — Gaudi smoke tests passed in lab, but SI egress/VPC peering is still blocked by net perms. Need a security ticket for VPC peering and egress exceptions. Raised ENG-1234: <https://jira/redwood/ENG-1234|ENG-1234>

olivia: Thanks. Action items: Sam escalate H100 firmware with @nvidia-eng; Alex validate MI300 canary with SI by EOD Friday; Jin file sec ticket & tag me; Maria gets a soft date (marketing wants 2w). Tentative soft date: 2024-05-10. Any objections?

sam: I'll escalate to @nvidia-eng + cc @hw-ps. If fix takes >48h, fallback plan is to start with H200 pool for initial marketplace listing. Can ops confirm H200 slot capacity?

alex: SI asked for our image hash and a tiny runbook. I'll post the sha and runbook shortly. SHA: `sha256:3a7b9f4c8e2d...f9a`. Runbook (short):
```
1) pull image: docker pull redwood/runtime:mi300-qfix-2024-03
2) run minimal perf: ./run_bench --seq 2048 --batch 4
3) report logs to #eng-runtime with tag `mi300-canary`
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed on gaudi-lab-3 — success — 2024-05-02T14:02:31Z :white_check_mark:

maria: Marketing ok with tentative 5/10, will draft joint statement but must include "subject to final QA and embargo". Want to review runbook notes before copy goes out.

jin: Sec ticket updated: <https://jira/redwood/ENG-1234|ENG-1234> — added security + network. Requested VPC peering approval and SI egress rule.

olivia: Great — summary of owners: Sam = H100 escalation + fallback coordination; Alex = MI300 canary + SI runbook; Jin = sec ticket & VPC peering; Maria = draft joint statement and embargo language. Reconvene Thu 11:00am PT for status. :thumbsup:
